steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Bass has a catchphrase. Do you know what it is?
Half of Eve's body has been devoured by toys and Mania. Yet she lets the contamination surge, and is calmly chatting with the toys all over her.
<color=#dg1f1f>What is it? Something that makes you sad just thinking about it, right?</color>

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: "Run, Bass. Run, Bass." ...He always yells like this in emergencies.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It seems like he learned it from some cartoon. He says that the louder he yells, the faster he can run!
She shakes her head in amusement.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The day of the explosion, his voice must have gone hoarse from yelling. He kept repeating, "Run, Eve! Run, Eve!"

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I can't run with these legs... I'm just a burden that everyone is forced to protect.
<color=#dg1f1f>It's okay! I will give you strength! Bass will always be with you as a toy! He now has the loudest voice! He can surely run fast, faster than the explosion!</color>
The pile of toys slowly surges towards Eve, knocking over several shelves along the way. But Eve is unfazed in her storytelling.
It seems like all the toys in the warehouse are rushing over to listen to Eve's story.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Benna never forgot that I have prosthetics for half of my body. He just often mistakes me for Shanna.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: He's forgotten a lot of things, but that just makes him more like a child.
<color=#dg1f1f>Maybe the elderly are just a type of child?</color>
<color=#dg1f1f>Your sorrow will be turned into power that can make him into a baby. As a baby, Benna would surely be treated well...</color>
The toys have flooded up to Eve's chest, and she's starting to feel short of breath. But upon seeing a toy puppy fall while climbing, she remembers something and chuckles.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Bone is the strongest, smartest, and bravest puppy I know.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Hard to believe, right? He has such a small body, but always rushes to the front to protect me.
<color=#dg1f1f>This time, you can give him the sharpest teeth! No one can kick him away ever again!</color>
The pace at which the toys are piling up has completely sped out of control. Eve is now choking at the throat, making it increasingly difficult to tell her story.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Polly... Huff...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Only the most perfect and beautiful doll in the world is worthy of Polly...
<color=#dg1f1f>Yes, yes! Give me more sorrow, more longing! I promise you, she will always be the most beautiful doll!</color>

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Cough cough cough... Maresa...
Mania has started to gnaw at Eve's will. She is now squeezing her words out from between her teeth.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm sorry, I couldn't find your child...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You will have many, many children...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The mama nesting doll is a lot like you...
The toys are no longer satisfied with devouring her. They pile up higher and higher, almost reaching the roof.
Eve can no longer feel the pain of suffocation. Her limbs are numb and cold. She's now just one of the many components of this behemoth.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Ah, it's...
In the increasingly narrow rift, she catches a glimpse of a strange figure rushing towards her.
The grey trench coat seems familiar, carrying the scent of her most familiar family members.
<color=#dg1f1f>He's a villain, a bad egg who's trying to stop you! The toy factory can only have toys! Give me your all, and I'll turn him into a toy!</color>
steps.female_content: <color=#dg1f1f>She's a villain, a bad egg who's trying to stop you! The toy factory can only have toys! Give me your all, and I'll turn her into a toy!</color>

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Is that so? All right, I'll listen to you. Don't let anyone stop... stop me... Huh? Stop me... from what?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Why am I here? What did I want to do in the first place?
The light in her eyes dims. Darkness, accompanied by evil sludge, is completely robbing her of her vision and perception.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve! Wake up!
